critical_code_review_comments: routes/srs.py:174-257 _gen_entity_model — clean, deterministic, no LLM. Layout uses sqrt-grid + circular per-domain spread; for the largest domain (>20 tables) collision radius is capped at 200px, so D3 force-collide (90) in the FE will likely re-spread — acceptable since FE uses force simulation.

routes/srs.py:411 — SRSDocument.model_dump() will include `frozen=False, frozen_at=None, frozen_by=None` defaults, overwriting any previously frozen state if regenerated; _load_srs_context guards against this with the frozen check (line 389), so safe.

routes/kb.py:346-373 download_owl — uses JSONResponse with custom Content-Type header which duplicates the default; harmless but consider removing the explicit 'Content-Type': 'application/json' line since JSONResponse sets it.

routes/projects.py:39-59 pipeline endpoint — projects with no StageContext docs always show all five as {frozen:false}; consider including a derived 'available' flag (e.g., DataModel is available if Discovery.frozen) so FE doesn't have to compute it twice (currently FE does this in Sidebar.stageStatus).
Sidebar.jsx:170 + 236-267 — nested buttons cause React hydration error (see frontend_issues.design_issues). Pre-existing pattern not introduced by this task.
